entities.title: Production
entities.summary: The laumufarthegi Worker at icelander.net/games/fresh/laumufarthegi*, with its static page and the Room Durable Object namespace.
entities.purpose: The game players reach at icelander.net/games/fresh/laumufarthegi/ and the room links they share.
entities.deployedBy: The Deploy workflow on every push to main that changes games/laumufarthegi outside its .dev folders (or anything under .github/ outside .github/.dev); or `npm run deploy` with a Cloudflare token. Run workflow's list of games does not name laumufarthegi, so it can be deployed by hand from Actions only with all.
approvals: A pull request: main accepts nothing else.
A reviewer on the repository's production environment, if one is set.
entities.rollback: No rollback is recorded. The Deploy workflow deploys only from main, so going back means merging a revert, which deploys it. Rooms live in Durable Object storage, which a deploy does not clear, so a change to the shape of State must still read rooms stored by the previous code.
entities.details: The Durable Object class Room is created by the rooms-v1 migration in wrangler.jsonc (new_sqlite_classes) when the Worker first deploys; there is no D1 database, so the database-migration gate has nothing of this game's to check. A change to games/word-lists/data/topic-grids.json alone does not deploy this game: changed-games.sh looks only under games/laumufarthegi/, so new topics go live with the game's next change.
